description: This file is a shell script used for testing Git rev-parse and rev-list commands with glob patterns and other options. It sets up a test repository, defines helper functions, and runs multiple test cases to verify behavior of glob-related options.

methods.name: commit
methods.description: Creates a commit with the given message by writing to a file, adding it, and committing.

methods.name: compare
methods.description: Compares the output of two git commands with different arguments and checks if they are identical.
